bug_semantics: Cross-tenant IDOR (CWE-639) in the multi-company payroll module of Prospero Flow CRM. GET /payroll (PayrollIndexController::index) listed rows with Payroll::where('period_year', $year) plus an optional request user_id filter and no mandatory company_id constraint on the related employee, so an authenticated user with 'read payroll' could read other companies' salary, IBAN, and notes. POST /payroll/save used PayrollRequest which validated user_id as required|exists:user,id (global existence), so a user with create payroll could attribute payroll rows to employees of another company. Other modules already scoped by Auth::user()->company_id.
flaw_origin: First written in reconstructed PR #258 member 33a30a5d0de8714198b063742405aa82ae9abda6 ('feat: New RRHH module with employee management, time tracking, payroll, and company holiday calendar'). That commit replaced the 2024 getAllByYear listing with an unscoped period_year query plus request user_id, and added PayrollRequest with exists:user,id. Immediate parent 9e4f84ece7e13c2c327540804dcaf841c6ac23fa has no PayrollRequest and still lists via getAllByYear. GitHub squash 04d1afd73226b1572fd19dc5ee5bbb55b82a1a64 is the same tree as follow-up 8369823e08d5ce346527ae6950a588619f821bc6 (payroll update route only) and is not the first-write. 5cc01ed958db4ad0a026a8daa1c6a8bb98a43e66 later added a company whereHas only when an employeeId filter was present; the default listing and the create-path exists rule stayed unscoped until the fix.
